sloka: यथाज्ञं कुरु सोमित्रे त्यज मां दुःखभागिनीम् ।निदेशे स्थीयतां राज्ञः शृणु चेदं वचो मम ।। ७.४८.९ ॥
transliteration: yathājñaṁ kuru somitre tyaja māṁ duḥkhabhāginīm ।nideśe sthīyatāṁ rājñaḥ śṛṇu cedaṁ vaco mama ।। 7.48.9 ॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana, do as commanded, abandon me, who is destined for sorrow, remain steadfast in the king's command, and listen to these words of mine.
